# Folsom Single-Story Homes

> Folsom Single-Story Homes is a free Folsom, CA guide by Scott Kirk, Broker/Owner, Weichert, Realtors - Sierra Pacific Group (CA DRE 01879787, corporate DRE 02088790), 705 Gold Lake Dr., Suite 250, Folsom, CA 95630, 916-847-5822, scott@wrspg.com. Every figure comes from MetroList (the regional MLS) or a named public record, with the source listed on the page. Data updated November 2026.

## Pages

- [Single-Story Homes in Folsom, CA by Neighborhood | Scott Kirk](https://folsomsinglestoryhomes.com/): Which Folsom, CA neighborhoods have the most single-story homes, what they sell for next to two-story homes, and how fast they sell. From MetroList. By Scott Kirk.
- [Downsizing in Folsom After 55: Single-Story Homes, 55+ Communities, Prop 19](https://folsomsinglestoryhomes.com/downsizing-55/): How to downsize to a single-story home in Folsom, CA after 55: where single-story homes sell, 55+ communities, the yearly cost to own and Prop 19.
- [Single-Story Homes in Folsom Under $700,000: Where They Sell](https://folsomsinglestoryhomes.com/single-story-under-700k/): Where single-story homes sold for under $700,000 in Folsom, CA, by neighborhood, and about how much home $700,000 buys. From MetroList sales, the 12 months from Nov 1, 2025 to Oct 31, 2026.
- [Single-Story Homes in Broadstone, Folsom CA: Sales, Prices, Speed](https://folsomsinglestoryhomes.com/broadstone/): How many Broadstone homes that sold were single-story, what they sold for, how fast, and the tax and HOA costs. From MetroList sales, the 12 months from Nov 1, 2025 to Oct 31, 2026.
- [Single-Story Homes in Empire Ranch, Folsom CA: Sales, Prices, Speed](https://folsomsinglestoryhomes.com/empire-ranch/): How many Empire Ranch homes that sold were single-story, what they sold for, how fast, and the tax and HOA costs. From MetroList sales, the 12 months from Nov 1, 2025 to Oct 31, 2026.
- [Ready for Something Smaller: A Folsom Downsizing Story | Scott Kirk](https://folsomsinglestoryhomes.com/story/): Matt and Lori K. wanted a smaller, single-story home in Folsom. How we worked out sell first or buy first, and what was worth fixing before listing.
- [Common Questions | Folsom Single-Story Homes](https://folsomsinglestoryhomes.com/questions/): Short, sourced answers about single-story homes in Folsom: where they sell, what they cost and the 55+ options, by Scott Kirk, Weichert, Realtors - Sierra Pacific Group.
- [Folsom Single-Story Homes by the Numbers | Folsom Single-Story Homes](https://folsomsinglestoryhomes.com/numbers/): Sourced figures on single-story home sales in Folsom, CA: share by neighborhood, prices per square foot, days on market, the 55+ communities and Prop 19. By Scott Kirk.
- [Sources and Method | Folsom Single-Story Homes](https://folsomsinglestoryhomes.com/method/): Where every number on Folsom Single-Story Homes comes from.
